description: This file defines a FavoritesRepository class responsible for managing favorite VOD item IDs using Android's SharedPreferences. It includes methods to get, add, remove, and toggle favorites, with internal constants for preferences key names.

classes.name: FavoritesRepository
classes.description: A repository class for persisting favorite VOD item IDs using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getFavoriteIds
methods.description: Retrieves the set of favorite VOD item IDs.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a specific ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: addFavorite
methods.description: Adds a VOD item ID to the favorites.

methods.name: removeFavorite
methods.description: Removes a VOD item ID from the favorites.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a VOD item ID.
